intro: Guard Captain Malkhor has been lost, and Revantusk's guard needs a new captain. Anyone who wants the post must wipe out Vilebranch Berserkers, Shadow Hunters, Blood Drinkers and Soul Eaters, then bring an application to Primal Torntusk in the Hinterlands.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: With the loss of Guard Captain Malkhor, the position of Guard Captain of Revantusk is once again open. If you are interested in becoming Captain of the Guard for Revantusk, complete the following tasks and submit your application to Primal Torntusk:

clips.title: Progress
paras: Are you here about the job opening?

clips.title: Completion
paras: You are indeed a worthy candidate for the new position, friend. Accept this trinket as a token of our appreciation for your hard work. I will be reviewing all applications next year.
